summary: Implemented the terminal window title feature without running any tests or repository code, and without committing. Changes: rich/segment.py adds SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and admits Tuple[ControlType, str] in ControlCode. rich/control.py adds the formatting entry (OSC 0 with BEL terminator) and the Control.title classmethod, which passes a single two-item tuple to the constructor. rich/console.py adds set_window_title, gated only on is_terminal, returning True when written and False otherwise, with the required docstring warnings. rich/_windows_renderer.py adds a SET_WINDOW_TITLE branch that calls term.set_title(title) once. CHANGELOG.md gets an Added heading above Fixed with a bullet linking PR 2200. Tests added: test_control_title, test_set_window_title (returns early on legacy consoles), and test_control_set_window_title (Windows-only via the existing module marker). All verification was by reading the code only; the tests have not been executed.
